dataset: MNIST + FashionMNIST (public, MNIST public-domain, FashionMNIST MIT), local campaign2/data
provenance: torchvision official mirror; downloaded for this campaign
question: can N1 identify novelty whose downstream error is reducible by a bounded intervention while rejecting irreducible noise/OOD
mechanism: best of capable estimators (knn, kernel_ridge, rff) predicting MEASURED reducibility from decision-time features (logits, entropy, margin, maxprob, feature-norm, novelty distance)
intervention: test-time-augmentation ensemble inference (K=8 augmented forward passes), real compute cost
oracle: allocate intervention budget to top MEASURED reducibility
primary_metric: fraction of oracle headroom over random captured
claim_ceiling: real-data CANARY evidence; a positive licenses ONE larger independent-confirmation experiment (more sources/tasks/implementations), NOT activation and NOT scientific confirmation by itself
stop_rule: terminal after one canary; a tie is a null; wrong-direction fails
